To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the intralateral ventricle inoculation is a good method to induce brain metastasis without disruption of the blood brain barrier function and that several chemotherapeutic agents are highly effective against the brain metastasis.

the intralateral ventricle administration of antitumor agents was effective in the rat models of meningeal tumors, and that these models may be suitable for the screening of new chemotherapeutic drugs effective for the meningeal metastasis of leukemia.

intralateral- ventricle inoculation is an effective method for establishing a brain metastasis model and that intralateral ventricle administration of antitumor agents is a promising method for the treatment of brain metastasis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new models of brain tumor and with the screening of new agents for the treatment of brain tumor.

the development of new models for the evaluation of the antitumor effect of chemotherapeutic agents against leptomeningeally spread tumors, and with the establishment of the most effective administration route of the drugs.

the establishment and evaluation of the experimental brain tumor models for the chemotherapy of brain tumor, and the results obtained in the two models may be applicable to the chemotherapy of brain tumors in human beings.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the intralateral ventricle inoculation technique for brain tumor models is useful for evaluating antitumor agents for the treatment of brain tumors, especially leptomeningeally disseminated tumors.
the two rat models of lepto-meningeal tumors are useful for the screening of new antitumor agents effective for human leptomeningeally disseminated neoplasms.
the rat models of lepto-meningeal tumors developed in our laboratory are very useful in screening new chemotheraputic agents against brain tumors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the rat models of lepto-meningeal tumors by intrathecal-ventricle injection are useful for the screening of new antitumor agents effective for human meningeal tumors.
the two models developed in this study are useful for screening of chemotherapeutic agents for leptomeningeals and/or brain tumors.

intravenous or intralateral- ventricle administration of ACNU, intraperitoneal or intralateral ventricle administration spirohydantonin mustard, and intraperitoneal, intralateral-ventricle, or intracarotid administration of methotrxate were highly effective against brain metastasis of DBLA- 6 or AH130.
The main takeaway from our work is that
intralateral- ventricle administration of chemotherapeutic agents may be a promising approach to the chemotherapy of meningeal leukemia and/or brain metastasis.

intraperitoneally administered ACNU and intralateral ventricular administration of MTX are promising for the treatment of meningeal leukemia and that intralateral- ventricle administration of spiro-hydantoin mustard and 5-fluoro-deoxyuridine are promising for the chemotherapy of meningeal carcinomatosis.
